title: Maize — Harvest, Drying and Storage
content:
MAIZE HARVEST:

MATURITY INDICATORS:
- Black layer formation at base of kernel (hilum).
- Husk turns brown and dry — loosens from ear.
- Grain moisture: 30-35% at black layer, target 20-25% for mechanical harvest.
- Days to maturity: Hybrids 90-110 days, OPV 95-120 days.

HARVEST METHOD:
- Manual: Twist and pull ear, husk immediately. Threshold on concrete or tarpaulin.
- Combine harvester: Corn header attachment. Harvest at 20-22% grain moisture.
- Avoid harvesting too early (high moisture) or too late (shattering).

DRYING:
- Sun drying on cob: Place in windrows 7-10 days to reduce to 15% moisture.
- Shelling: Shell only when moisture < 15% to prevent breakage.
- Mechanical dryer: 45-50°C for 8-10 hours for rapid drying.
- Target storage moisture: 12-13% (hermetic) or 13% (gunny bags).

STORAGE:
- Hermetic bags (GrainPro/PICS bags): Best option. Zero pesticide needed if properly sealed.
- Gunny bags: At 12-13% moisture. Stack on pallets. Fumigate with Aluminium Phosphide @ 3 tablets/tonne.
- Grain protectants: Malathion 5% DP @ 25g/100 kg if chemical storage needed.
- Monitor for Maize weevil (Sitophilus zeamais) — most destructive storage pest.

YIELD:
- Hybrid (kharif irrigated): 8-12 t/ha grain.
- OPV (kharif): 5-7 t/ha.
- Hybrid (rabi irrigated): 9-12 t/ha.
- Rainfed: 3-5 t/ha.

POST-HARVEST VALUE ADDITION:
- Baby corn: Harvest at silk emergence (2-3 cm silk). High value crop.
- Sweet corn: Harvest at milk stage (18-20 DAP from silking).
